strings.If [[Avg. VWC]] is grey and italic, the: If [[Avg. VWC]] is grey and italic, the value is modelled from an older scan, so the suggestion rests on an estimate.

strings.If [[Bulk Adjust Error]] appears, reload: If [[Bulk Adjust Error]] appears, reload the page and check [[Target VWC]] before you try again.
strings.If [[Bulk Adjust]] stays grey, no row is: If [[Bulk Adjust]] stays grey, no row is ticked. Tick a station row, or a hole row to take all its stations.
strings.If [[Exclude Zeros]] is greyed out, sele: If [[Exclude Zeros]] is greyed out, select [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]] first.

strings.If [[Over/Under]] shows a dash, no filte: If [[Over/Under]] shows a dash, no filter is set yet, or no station matches it. The next steps set one.
strings.If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, no ch: If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, no change is waiting.
strings.If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, nothi: If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, nothing is waiting or a push is still running.

strings.If [[Pushed Today]] rows became ticked,: If [[Pushed Today]] rows became ticked, you used the box beside [[Changes]] in the heading, which ticks both lists. Untick the rows you did not mean.
strings.If [[Request Failed]] shows instead, the: If [[Request Failed]] shows instead, the request did not queue. Select the button again.
strings.If [[Save]] is greyed out, nothing has c: If [[Save]] is greyed out, nothing has changed or a value is outside 1 to 200.
strings.If [[Set to zero when pushed to Lynx]] i: If [[Set to zero when pushed to Lynx]] is selected, small changes go to Lynx as 0. To keep those stations running, select [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]], then select [[Save Changes]].
strings.If [[Suggested]] shows the same top valu: If [[Suggested]] shows the same top value on many rows, the daily maximum is capping it.
strings.If [[Suggested]] sits at the same top va: If [[Suggested]] sits at the same top value on many rows, the daily maximum is capping it. See Calculation settings.
strings.If [[Suggested]] stays at the same top v: If [[Suggested]] stays at the same top value, the daily maximum is capping it rather than the target.
strings.If a dash shows in place of the box, the: If a dash shows in place of the box, the station has no current scan and no modelled value, so there is nothing to adjust.
strings.If a digit does not appear, it would tak: If a digit does not appear, it would take the number above 15. The box refuses it.

strings.If a message says Unable to save data, t: If a message says Unable to save data, the save failed and the dialog is still open. Select [[Save Changes]] again.
strings.If a new name is lost, the dialog was ca: If a new name is lost, the dialog was cancelled. Rename the slot again and select [[Save Changes]].
strings.If a pin is clear, it was last scanned o: If a pin is clear, it was last scanned on an earlier day. A disabled station has no pin while [[Layers]] is set to [[Enabled Stations]].
strings.If a pin stays clear, it was not scanned: If a pin stays clear, it was not scanned today, so it has no variance.
strings.If a station is not in the table, it has: If a station is not in the table, it has no recent scan. The profile still captures its stored target.
strings.If a station you expect has no pin, [[La: If a station you expect has no pin, [[Layers]] may be set to [[Enabled Stations]], the default.
strings.If a station you switched off is still o: If a station you switched off is still on the map, another sprinkler of that station may still be on.
strings.If a tip about selecting stations appear: If a tip about selecting stations appears, you chose [[Bulk Adjust]]. Select the link to its right.
strings.If a value box stays grey, its end is no: If a value box stays grey, its end is not ticked. Tick it, then type the value.
strings.If a value does not match, the station i: If a value does not match, the station is treated as failed, and the next phase retries it.
strings.If a value is grey and italic, no scan a: If a value is grey and italic, no scan arrived today. It is modelled instead.
strings.If a value looks wrong, select [[Cancel]: If a value looks wrong, select [[Cancel]] and fix it in the table first. Nothing has been sent yet.
strings.If access or scan data is missing, that: If access or scan data is missing, that explains scans that never arrive, and the cause is not in your settings.
strings.If all three boxes are greyed out, the s: If all three boxes are greyed out, the site uses [[Option 1]], which uses none of them. Calculation methods explains the two methods.
strings.If another dialog is open, close it firs: If another dialog is open, close it first. The gear is just right of [[Announcements]].
strings.If both choices are greyed out, the box: If both choices are greyed out, the box above holds 0. Type a number above 0 first.
strings.If both options are greyed out, the thre: If both options are greyed out, the threshold is 0, which turns the feature off.
strings.If both read --, the slot is empty and c: If both read --, the slot is empty and cannot be applied. Fill it first: see Capturing profiles.
strings.If Can ping cloud shows false, or a bann: If Can ping cloud shows false, or a banner above the toolbar says the connection to Lynx is lost, re-pushing will not help. Check the connection to Lynx first.
strings.If every value is grey and italic, nothi: If every value is grey and italic, nothing was scanned today. See Get fresh scan data.
strings.If it names stations that could not be u: If it names stations that could not be updated, check the connection to Lynx, then follow Push failures.
If it names stations that could not be updated, select [[Close]] and follow Push failures.
strings.If it opens on [[Minimum Threshold]], yo: If it opens on [[Minimum Threshold]], you used [[Review Threshold]] since the page loaded. The next step picks the tab you need.
strings.If it reads 0, the threshold is off and: If it reads 0, the threshold is off and the options are greyed out. The setting is site-wide, so someone else may have cleared it.
strings.If most of the course shows that value,: If most of the course shows that value, the cap is deciding, not the scan. Raise Daily Max Amount in [[Settings]] › [[Calculation]] if it is too low.
strings.If no box opens and the stations beneath: If no box opens and the stations beneath did not change, Shift was not held. Without Shift, the switch changes only its own row.
strings.If no name looks right, a slot may have: If no name looks right, a slot may have been renamed. A rename also changes its date, which can help.
strings.If no pin is outlined, the station may b: If no pin is outlined, the station may be disabled and hidden. Set [[Layers]] to [[All Stations]].
strings.If no sprinkler has the icon, each was s: If no sprinkler has the icon, each was scanned today, or the site uses [[Option 1]]. Under [[Option 1]], a sprinkler not scanned today shows --.
strings.If no station has a chevron, none of the: If no station has a chevron, none of them has more than one sprinkler. There is nothing to expand here.
strings.If no value is grey, every station was s: If no value is grey, every station was scanned today, or [[Option 1]] is set in Settings, which models nothing.
strings.If nothing changes, let go of the handle: If nothing changes, let go of the handle. The map recolours when you release it.
strings.If nothing opens, [[Push Changes]] is gr: If nothing opens, [[Push Changes]] is greyed out because nothing is waiting.
strings.If nothing opens, you may have cleared a: If nothing opens, you may have cleared an earlier choice on that row. Select the icon again.
strings.If numbers still look the same after you: If numbers still look the same after you save, check that the box shows the format you want.
If one date is old, that is one station. If every date is old, no setting will fix it, so go on to request the data.
strings.If scans still do not arrive: If scans still do not arrive
strings.If some text stays in English after you: If some text stays in English after you save, the product has no translation for it. The tab names in the left rail are always English.
strings.If suggestions later look far too high,: If suggestions later look far too high, this number is too low. It should match what a station applies at 100%.
strings.If the [[Push Changes]] dialog is not op: If the [[Push Changes]] dialog is not open, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar first.
strings.If the average is not the mean of every: If the average is not the mean of every row below it, a sprinkler was left out. Only sprinklers scanned today, or modelled under [[Option 2]], count.
strings.If the banner has gone, [[Dismiss]] only: If the banner has gone, [[Dismiss]] only hides it. The next time the dashboard loads its data, it picks the new scan up.
strings.If the bar drops back to 0 near the end,: If the bar drops back to 0 near the end, a retry has begun for the stations that failed. Let it run.
strings.If the bar drops from nearly full to 0,: If the bar drops from nearly full to 0, that is the retry starting, not the push failing.
strings.If the bar seems slow on a large course,: If the bar seems slow on a large course, that is normal: each station takes at least a tenth of a second.
strings.If the box already holds a number, it is: If the box already holds a number, it is your last amount for that choice, or the default. Type over it.
strings.If the box does not open, select [[Layer: If the box does not open, select [[Layers]] again. Selecting anywhere else closes it.
strings.If the box is greyed out, the site uses: If the box is greyed out, the site uses [[Option 1]], which uses no ET. The two amounts above it are greyed out too.
strings.If the box is not there, the site uses [: If the box is not there, the site uses [[Option 2]]. On a production site it shows only while the site uses [[Option 1]].
strings.If the box shows --, the station has no: If the box shows --, the station has no scan today and no modelled value, so there is nothing to override.
strings.If the box shows a number you did not ex: If the box shows a number you did not expect, check which choice is marked.
strings.If the ceiling is too low for your cours: If the ceiling is too low for your course, raise Daily Max Amount, then select [[Save Changes]]. Lowering Lynx Reference Amount raises every uncapped suggestion as well.
strings.If the count is higher than you expect,: If the count is higher than you expect, untick the rows you do not want. Their edits stay in the table for next time.
strings.If the count is not what you expect, sel: If the count is not what you expect, select [[Cancel]] and fix the ticks first.
strings.If the date is old but TurfRad access an: If the date is old but TurfRad access and scan data are fine, select [[Request latest scan data]] in the toolbar. It cannot make TurfRad scan, so the date stays old if TurfRad has nothing newer.
strings.If the date is older, [[Option 2]] shows: If the date is older, [[Option 2]] shows a modelled [[Avg. VWC]], in grey italics. If every station is old, select [[Request latest scan data]] in the toolbar, then [[Reload Data]] on the banner.
strings.If the dialog is closed, select [[Push C: If the dialog is closed, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar. If rows under Available to Push are ticked that you did not mean to send, untick them.
strings.If the dialog is not open, select [[Push: If the dialog is not open, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar. If there is no banner, see the last step.
strings.If the dialog stays open with [[Unable t: If the dialog stays open with [[Unable to save data]], the save did not finish. Reload the page and check the profile list before you try again.
strings.If the editor is not open, hold Shift +: If the editor is not open, hold Shift + Alt and select the gear, [[Settings]]. To find the station, type its name under Filter station.
strings.If the last scan date is not today, no s: If the last scan date is not today, no scan from today has reached Spatial Adjust yet. If nothing opens, wait a second or so after the page loads and click again.
strings.If the list does not open, select [[Laye: If the list does not open, select [[Layers]] again.
strings.If the mark goes away, you selected the: If the mark goes away, you selected the icon twice. Select it once more.
strings.If the name is missing, a target was edi: If the name is missing, a target was edited after you applied the profile. The stored profile is unchanged.
strings.If the name is still there, no target ha: If the name is still there, no target has changed since you applied it. There is nothing to update.
strings.If the profile’s name is not above the t: If the profile’s name is not above the table, it was not applied, or a target has been edited since.
strings.If the rail has no [[Target Profiles]],: If the rail has no [[Target Profiles]], your IntelliDash predates it. Change targets in the table instead.
strings.If the row did not open, you selected th: If the row did not open, you selected the station name, which only selects the station. Select the chevron.
strings.If the row has no icon, no sprinkler und: If the row has no icon, no sprinkler under it is modelled.
strings.If the row shows [[Avg. Target VWC]], it: If the row shows [[Avg. Target VWC]], it is a hole or area row. Select a hole row to see its stations.
strings.If the row shows 0 and not a dash, the c: If the row shows 0 and not a dash, the calculation ran and asked for no water. Follow Why is this station 0%?
strings.If the rows are areas or holes, they sho: If the rows are areas or holes, they show averages only. Select a row to open the next level, until you reach stations.
strings.If the rows are areas or holes, you are: If the rows are areas or holes, you are not at station level. Select a row name to go down until stations show.
strings.If the run stalls here, Spatial Adjust i: If the run stalls here, Spatial Adjust is waiting for Lynx to answer. If it never moves on, check the connection to Lynx.
strings.If the scans stay old, select [[Request: If the scans stay old, select [[Request latest scan data]]. It looks back only two days, so the scans change only if TurfRad has loaded new scan data in that time.
strings.If the slot shows a station count, it al: If the slot shows a station count, it already holds a profile, and capturing into it replaces what it holds. Use a slot that shows -- if you have one.
strings.If the switch is off, Lynx keeps the val: If the switch is off, Lynx keeps the value it holds, but the suggestion is still calculated. Check the area and hole switches above the station too.
strings.If the table lists areas, select the are: If the table lists areas, select the area row first. If you know where the station is, select its pin on the map instead.
strings.If the value is not grey and italic, it: If the value is not grey and italic, it is a measurement from a scan taken today.
strings.If the values all differ, the cap is not: If the values all differ, the cap is not involved. Check whether each value is measured, modelled or a dash.
strings.If the values look the same as before, t: If the values look the same as before, the method did not change. Reopen [[Settings]] and check [[Suggested Percent Adjust Calculation]].
strings.If the values spread out with no repeats: If the values spread out with no repeats, the site may use [[Option 1]], which has no cap. Its values can go far higher than you intend on a very dry station.
strings.If the weather strip still shows the old: If the weather strip still shows the old scale later, the change was not saved. Choose it again and select [[Save Changes]].
strings.If the whole course is stale, check the: If the whole course is stale, check the source
strings.If the window closed with no result, Spa: If the window closed with no result, Spatial Adjust could not read Lynx back. Check the connection to Lynx.
strings.If there is no banner, the threshold cha: If there is no banner, the threshold changed no station or is set to 0, so there is nothing to check.

strings.If there is no chart, the screen is 1400: If there is no chart, the screen is 1400 px wide or narrower, which hides it. Use a wider window.
strings.If there is no course list by the site n: If there is no course list by the site name, the site has only one Lynx course.
strings.If there is no exclamation mark, the cho: If there is no exclamation mark, the choice was cancelled. Select the icon under [[Apply Profile]] again.
strings.If there is no left rail, Settings is no: If there is no left rail, Settings is not open. Select the gear button, [[Settings]], at the right of the toolbar.
strings.If there is no pink banner, no waiting s: If there is no pink banner, no waiting station is below the threshold. Nothing is changed by it this time.
strings.If they changed, the save did more, such: If they changed, the save did more, such as applying a profile or changing a calculation setting.
strings.If they show the old scale, open Setting: If they show the old scale, open Settings again and check [[Temperature Scale]] on the [[Preferences]] tab.
strings.If this is not the change you want, sele: If this is not the change you want, select [[Cancel]]. The switch goes back to how it was, and nothing is saved.
strings.If you also changed Units of Measure in: If you also changed Units of Measure in this visit, the amounts were saved rescaled by 25.4. Reopen [[Settings]] and check Daily Max Amount and Lynx Reference Amount before you push.
strings.If you are asked whether to leave withou: If you are asked whether to leave without saving, you changed something. Select [[Discard changes]] to drop it.
strings.If you can type in them, the site uses [: If you can type in them, the site uses [[Option 2]], the method these three boxes feed.
strings.If you cannot find it, look between the: If you cannot find it, look between the pushed-today counter and the gear.
strings.If you change Units of Measure and save: If you change Units of Measure and save in the same visit, the saved amounts are rescaled by 25.4. Reopen [[Settings]] and check Daily Max Amount and Lynx Reference Amount before you push.
strings.If you expected a range, read it again:: If you expected a range, read it again: 200 and 10 show everything over 200% and everything under 10%.
strings.If you expected the threshold here, it i: If you expected the threshold here, it is applied only in the [[Push Changes]] dialog and to what is sent to Lynx.
strings.If you need to change one of those stati: If you need to change one of those stations again today, tick its row.
strings.If you push again by hand straight after: If you push again by hand straight after a failure, that is a fourth attempt over the same connection. Check the connection first.
strings.If you see [[Target VWC]] boxes, you are: If you see [[Target VWC]] boxes, you are at station level. Select the area’s name at the top left to go up.
strings.If you see an error page, check the addr: If you see an error page, check the address. A camelCase address such as /spatialAdjust does not work.
strings.If you see another tab, select [[Minimum: If you see another tab, select [[Minimum Threshold]] again; Settings opens on [[Calculation]]. If there is no left rail, select the gear button, [[Settings]], at the right of the toolbar.
strings.If you see no pins, the site has no scan: If you see no pins, the site has no scan from the past seven days. See Get fresh scan data.
strings.If you select [[Cancel]] with the box ti: If you select [[Cancel]] with the box ticked, nothing is saved, and the prompt keeps coming.
strings.If you select [[Cancel]], nothing change: If you select [[Cancel]], nothing changes. Open the options again to set them.
strings.If you went too far, select a name in th: If you went too far, select a name in the trail at the top left of the table to go back up.

strings.In Lynx, Site Adjust and Course Adjust m: In Lynx, Site Adjust and Course Adjust must both be 100%. Any other value is applied on top of every percentage you push, so the whole course waters more or less than the dashboard shows, and nothing reports an error.
